description: We are ADAPT, interested in AI, software development, health monitoring, and space technology. We aim to create astronaut health monitoring software connected with the spacesuit to track vital signs and suit data in real time. We welcome members interested in Python, AI/ML, IoT, sensors, embedded systems, data analysis, UI/UX, cybersecurity, and aerospace technology. Join us.
summary: Adapt Revive Astronaut Health Monitoring Neckband that capture and analysis human body signal node to find out error. Then our system analysis the error in human body to find disease or injury and it’s location. After that it sends data to portable device, so that doctor or astronaut can give treatment basis on that report. It's use electromagnetic motion analyzer with thermal and pressure of human body. We used a new technology electro node catcher.
details: Project Name: ADAPT Revive Mission: Saving Human Lives on Earth and in Space Event: NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 Project Type: Smart Wearable Health Monitoring System Core Technology: Human Bioelectrical Signal Analysis Device: ADAPT Revive Smart Neckband Signal Detection: Proposed Electromagnetic Motion Analyzer Monitoring Method: Continuous, Non-Invasive Physiological Monitoring Primary Objective: Early Detection of Potential Diseases, Injuries, and Physiological Abnormalities Neural Signals: Nervous System Activity Monitoring Cardiovascular Signals: Heart and Circulatory Activity Monitoring Muscular Signals: Muscle Activity and Response Monitoring Skeletal Health: Musculoskeletal Health Assessment Additional Sensors: Thermal and Pressure Sensors Environmental Analysis: Temperature, Pressure, and Weather Data Comparison Data Processing: Continuous Signal Collection, Translation, and Analysis Software: ADAPT Revive Health Monitoring Platform Connectivity: Continuous Data Transmission to Connected Portable Devices Health Alerts: Automated Notifications for Potential Physiological Abnormalities Target Users: Astronauts, Doctors, Patients, and Individuals in Remote Locations Space Application: Autonomous Health Monitoring During Deep-Space Missions Earth Application: Personal Health Monitoring and Remote Healthcare Support Key Innovation: Translating Human Physiological Signals into Understandable Health Information Development Status: Proposed Concept Requiring Scientific and Clinical Validation Future Vision: Accessible, Intelligent, Real-Time Health Monitoring Anywhere
